title: Alternating-strategy play sequence
statement: Given two strategies $s_1,s_2 : 	ext{List}(	ext{Bool})\to	ext{Bool}$ and a natural number $n$, the play sequence of length $n$ starts with the empty history and is formed by repeatedly appending one bit: at an even-length history append the bit chosen by $s_1$, and at an odd-length history append the bit chosen by $s_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Two strategies from Boolean lists to Boolean values
